def validate_token_parameters(params):
    """Validates token parameters from a token response."""
    # Check for error in response
    if 'error' in params:
        raise_from_error(params.get('error'), params)

    # Check for missing access token
    if 'access_token' not in params:
        raise MissingTokenError(description='Missing access token parameter.')

    # Check for missing token type (only strict mode)
    if os.environ.get('OAUTHLIB_STRICT_TOKEN_TYPE'):
        if 'token_type' not in params:
            raise MissingTokenTypeError()

    # Handle scope changes
    if params.scope_changed:
        if os.environ.get('OAUTHLIB_RELAX_TOKEN_SCOPE'):
            new_scope = params.scope
            old_scope = params.old_scope
            message = 'Scope has changed from "{old}" to "{new}".'.format(
                old=list_to_scope(old_scope),
                new=list_to_scope(new_scope),
            )
            scope_changed.send(message=message, old=old_scope, new=new_scope)
        else:
            raise Warning("Scope has changed from \"%s\" to \"%s\"." % (
                list_to_scope(params.old_scope), list_to_scope(params.scope)))
